blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: method mark — Award for correct reasoning step.
transfer — Applying learning to unfamiliar problem.

blocks.title: Diagnose rather than praise vaguely
blocks.text: Separate inaccurate knowledge, missing context and absent justification; use an explicit improvement target.

blocks.title: Show full method
blocks.text: Write intermediary calculations, trace states and correctly named registers or SQL keys.

blocks.title: Demonstrate transfer
blocks.text: Apply the improved method to a different question, not a copied mark-scheme answer.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: Name the mechanism—overlapping stages of different instructions—rather than speeding an individual stage.

blocks.title: Worked example · Check reasoning
blocks.text: State a limitation, such as dependency stalls or branch flushes.
